targets.rawSql:
SELECT session_date AS time, max_weight_lbs
FROM workouts.v_session_exercise_metrics
WHERE canonical_name = '$exercise'
  AND max_weight_lbs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY session_date;

SELECT session_date AS time, session_volume
FROM workouts.v_session_exercise_metrics
WHERE canonical_name = '$exercise'
  AND session_metric = 'duration'
  AND session_volume IS NOT NULL
  AND session_volume > 0
ORDER BY session_date;

SELECT session_date AS time, progress_score
FROM workouts.v_session_exercise_metrics
WHERE canonical_name = '$exercise'
  AND session_metric = 'reps'
  AND progress_score IS NOT NULL
  AND progress_score > 0
ORDER BY session_date;

SELECT session_date, session_metric, max_weight_lbs, session_volume, progress_score_duration, progress_score_reps, progress_score, catalog_progress_metric
FROM workouts.v_session_exercise_metrics
WHERE canonical_name = '$exercise'
ORDER BY session_date DESC
LIMIT 30;
